verdict.rationale: The docs describe a quick-start guide where you create a Sandbox project, which grants the non-billable, unlimited Test Drive plan. From there you generate tokens with your Partner ID, secret and appKey, then link accounts via Connect using FinBank test personas. Client libraries are only shown as generated from the OpenAPI spec in Mastercard's GitHub test project, not as official per-language SDKs. missing for 10: official maintained client libraries in multiple languages, an explicit runnable end-to-end quickstart sample, evidence of time-to-first-linked-account or hands-on corroboration of self-serve speed.
